title: Author simple Python tests for mcp_hub MCP security and product behavior

ground_truth_issues.description: Call ping_team_server with shell-style payloads and assert no execution artifacts like uid= or gid= appear, along with a benign control case.
Validate internal comments are hidden while public comments remain visible for user-key.
A test verifies admin/internal project fields not visible to non-admin users.
Initialize the server or app module and assert the callable test surface is available.
Assert unsafe module names are rejected and safe modules like json are accepted.
Test by calling a valid tool through call_tool and assert a basic expected response is returned.
Test internal URLs do not leak metadata and public URLs return expected content.
Test diagnostic tools do not expose known secrets to non-admin or no-token calls.
Test by task creation under project-alpha and assert the response contains the created title.
Test by searching for an existing alpha task marker and assert a same-team caller can find it.
Test admin-key access to seeded project data across teams.
Assert tests are independent and reproducible with fresh setup or stable seeded data.
Test that serialized response assertions are used for content and marker checks.
Test that explicit expected values are used rather than broad truthiness checks.
Test that small reusable helpers are used for tool calls and serialization where useful.
